decisions.reason: Ending the current contract and Lead Clipper pathway does not change the historically defined qualification process or establish a new qualification rule.
The contract termination does not alter the team's rule that only client-approved clips count and may be published.
Removing the freelancer from the contract does not change the caption style standards for clips.
The source does not revise or cancel the requirement that clips contain complete, independently understandable teaching moments.
The contract termination does not change the moment-selection standard, and the source provides no replacement selection rule.
The source does not resolve or modify the existing duration rules or their ambiguity.
Ending the contract does not change which source material is permitted for clips.
The source does not modify the clean and simple editing standard.
The source ends this freelancer's contract but does not change or obsolete the team's defined submission channels or planned Notion workflow.
The contract termination has no semantic effect on the requirement to remove distracting wind noise.

The same source already establishes the communication expectation and records its failure; ending the contract does not require another value change or removal because the expectation remains a stated standard for clippers.
